scripts.//: Delegate to a workspace with `npm --prefix <dir> run <script>`, never with --workspace. Inside a lifecycle script npm ignores --workspace in either position and re-runs this root script forever.
scripts.//build: The thread caps keep a build on Hostinger (64 cores, 200-thread account limit) from starting one compiler thread per core; see deploy/hostinger/serve.js.
scripts.build: node scripts/check-env.mjs store --warn-only && UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=2 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2 TOKIO_WORKER_THREADS=2 npm --prefix apps/store run build
scripts.build:admin: node scripts/check-env.mjs admin --warn-only && UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=2 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2 TOKIO_WORKER_THREADS=2 npm --prefix apps/admin run build
scripts.//check-env: Strict gate — non-zero exit when a required var is missing. deploy/deploy.sh runs this before building; the build scripts above only warn so local builds are not blocked.
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/store run lint && npm --prefix apps/admin run lint
